scope: Original native pixels and visual source review only. No source edits, anatomical transforms, generated pixels, registration, public assets or completion credit.
units: native raster pixels; dimensions are projected visible contours, not 3D calibration

proposedCommonCrop.status: Coordinate conversion only; crop authoring and final asset recheck owned by parent. All dimensions unchanged.

proposedReleaseFixedAnchors.name: Exposed upper-right outer knee-pad edge
proposedReleaseFixedAnchors.method: Rightmost qualifying pixel in the exposed right pad ROI, then first qualifying y at that x. Actual pad boundary, not a canvas coordinate.

proposedReleaseFixedAnchors.name: Midpoint of exposed frontmost lower rounded knee-pad edge plateau
proposedReleaseFixedAnchors.method: Lowest qualifying pad row in exposed front pad ROI; midpoint of its qualifying x range. The rounded front corner has a real visible plateau, so a half-pixel midpoint is retained without rounding.

sensitivity.interpretation: Threshold40/45/50 gives the same y863 and front midpoint within1px across all sources and sampled thresholds. Thresholds20-35 can capture floor/shadow; those points are rejected as pad features.

proposedReleaseInvariantDimensions.name: Projected full visible pad horizontal extent
proposedReleaseInvariantDimensions.method: Rightmost exposed pad x minus leftmost exposed pad x, common neutral threshold40. Measures actual pad footprint extent.
proposedReleaseInvariantDimensions.caveat: Leftmost y is unstable on a rounded antialiased edge and is not selected as a fixed anchor.

proposedReleaseInvariantDimensions.name: Projected exposed bright-neutral tyre vertical contour span
proposedReleaseInvariantDimensions.method: At least10 consecutive neutral tyre pixels in each qualifying row, common brightness threshold30, outer top/bottom exposed tyre ROIs. Run filter excludes isolated human-outline anti-alias pixels.

sensitivity.interpretation: 193px at threshold30 across all3; threshold35 yields192/193/193px, within1%. Threshold40 erodes the dark lower tyre rim and is unsuitable for this contour.

proposedReleaseInvariantDimensions.caveat: This is a consistently defined visible raster tyre contour. It is not a true3D radius, unoccluded geometric diameter, axle length or calibrated grip-width claim.

additionalPadDiagnostic.name: Frontmost lower corner to upper-right corner projected distance
additionalPadDiagnostic.status: Additional observed pad footprint measurement; not needed as the second proposed release dimension.

rawOutOfLimitDiagnosticsRetained.shoeDiagnosticInterpretation: These brightness extrema show genuine small contour redraw/heel-pitch variation. They are not selected as release anchors/dimensions and must not be represented as passing1px/1%. The visible trainers remain supported without distracting sliding; no anatomy fitting was used.

visibleAxleEndcapProjectedHorizontalSpan.method: Neutral threshold30 near exposed left cap xmin to far exposed right cap xmax, using native endcap ROIs in equipment-readonly-extraction.json.
visibleAxleEndcapProjectedHorizontalSpan.interpretation: A real10.03%2D shortening of exposed endcap extent; not proof of changing3D shaft length. No camera/yaw explanation is established. It is minor exposed-tip/projection drawing variation visually: both grips remain around one axle, connected to one hub, with a comparable tyre and no gross equipment/contact break.

rawOutOfLimitDiagnosticsRetained.kneeContours: Independent cycle reviewer recorded near silhouette around(+1,+1),far(+3,+1) versus Brace. These exceed a blanket1px contour claim, remain small visible redraws, and are disclosed. This review does not force knee locations into1px.

rejectedMeasurementAttempts: Leftmost pad bright pixel y varies822/815/818 on rounded edge; unsuitable as fixed anchor.

First wheel neutral pixel without a contiguous run is contaminated by human forearm contour anti-aliases; initial top/bottom spans in equipment-readonly-extraction.json are not wheel-radius measurements.
Threshold20-35 lower pad ROI can capture the floor shadow to its ROI boundary; rejected, not accepted as a pad anchor.
Projected head bounding-box height varies with head pitch and visible chin/neck articulation; it cannot establish an invariant skull length.

nativePhysicalReview.sequence: Three genuinely different intact configurations: upright kneeling brace, mid rollout with shoulder/hip travel, and longer controlled reach; reverse reuse is truthful for a controlled return.
nativePhysicalReview.endpoint: Reach retains residual hip flexion and a neutral braced trunk. Do not label perfectly straight or fully horizontal. It visibly stays clear of the floor without lumbar sag or chest collapse.
nativePhysicalReview.contacts: Both knees remain supported on the pad; rear trainers rest behind them; both hands appear to retain closed grips on the single axle/hub throughout. Forward wheel y travel follows the oblique ground plane and is not alone evidence of losing floor contact.
nativePhysicalReview.identity: Native full sources and FA56 were visually inspected. Same bald faceless lean pale anatomical identity, no shorts or waistband, smooth neutral featureless pelvis and white trainers. No gross head/body scale switch or malformed joint/limb is apparent. Head pitch and limb foreshortening change; exact3D proportions cannot be proved from2D rasters.
nativePhysicalReview.equipment: One tyre with comparable visible contour dimensions and persistent hub/grips. Exposed shaft tips shorten in projection; minor drawing variation is present and disclosed, not an exact rigid-shaft pass.
nativePhysicalReview.colour: Native source palette is not certified as final exact primary/secondary release colours. Ordinary approved colour/contour finishing and final native/mobile review remain separate gates.
nativePhysicalReview.judgment: Native physical sequence is usable for a controlled-range kneeling rollout proposal under the revised allowance for small nondistracting contour variation. Raw source pad anchors and measured pad/tyre projected dimensions satisfy the proposed1px/1% checks. This is not final release acceptance.
